chapter: Arriving in New York: the Nest Club and Harlem nightlife
title: Nicodemus, the Stepin Fetchit-type comedian
summary: Danny and Milt talk about the comedian Nicodemus and his drawling stage persona.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Did you ever see this guy Nicodemus, a comedian?
Yeah. He finally wound up being kind of close to Mae West, didn't he.

Well, she... Nico... Yeah. Well, she...she respected performers, and she loved prizefighters, she loved wrestlers. She loved the big He-Men, those big, muscular guys. She always kept two or three bodyguards with her.

Well, Nicodemus, he was supposed to have been a great comedian. but he... I never seen him perform because he didn't want to talk. And I couldn't... It was a mystery to me how he survived, how he made money to live.
Well, he was on the type of...the Stepin' Fetchit type of thing.
Yeah, one of them things. Yeah, a slow-talking, drawlin', Southern...
And he portrayed that. Well, they were getting out the market from that, of portraying these things
in a way. And even though he was considered... He made a movie, and that gave him his acclaim. But after that, he never done too much.
